text.p: London's FirstBus Plc on Tuesday clinched its 54 million stg recommended acquisition of CentreWest, a rival regional bus company in the capital.

FirstBus, which operates local bus services in west, central and south-east London, said it had won acceptances for 97.9 percent of CentreWest's shares and promptly declared the purchase unconditional.
"This is an important opportunity to operate in greater London and enables us to gain further experience in the competitive tendering market," said Moir Lockhead, FirstBus's chief executive.

CentreWest also operates local bus services in west, central and south east London under contract to London Transport Buses and additionally operates commercial and tendered operations in Berkshire and Buckinghamshire.
